Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK: Operation was successful E_NOT_OK: Operation failed Description Gets the indicator status derived from the UDS status. API Availability: This API will be available only if ({ecuc(Dem/DemGeneral/DemEventMemory Set/DemIndicator)} != NULL) Available via Dem.h
